title: Drift Wood #1 · the cafeteria
logline: Wood vs. the lunch line. Truffaut to a lunch lady. Corn.

panels.composition: The cafeteria serving line. A tray of tater tots and a steel pan of corn under a heat lamp. WOOD (17, the oversized wool overcoat, indoors) leans over the tray toward a LUNCH LADY who is not looking at him.

characters.pose: leaning forward over the tray, one hand gesturing

balloons.text: Do you ever consider that this room is the only place in Small Wood where three hundred people voluntarily sit in the same direction?

image.prompt: a gaunt teenage boy in an oversized wool overcoat leaning over a cafeteria tray toward a bored lunch lady with a ladle, serving line with a sneeze guard and a heat lamp, fluorescent glare, 1990s high school cafeteria
image.notes: Wood's balloon is huge and crowds the panel — the cluttered balloons are the era.

panels.composition: Two-shot at the counter. The lunch lady, ladle raised, finally looks at him.

image.prompt: close two-shot across a cafeteria counter, a lunch lady with a raised ladle giving a flat stare to a gaunt teenage boy in an overcoat, steam rising

panels.composition: Wood turns to the reader, tray in hand, as if to a camera. Behind him the line moves on without him.

characters.pose: turned to the reader, tray held like a lectern

balloons.text: Truffaut said the film of tomorrow will be an act of love. I said corn.

image.prompt: a teenage boy in a wool overcoat holding a cafeteria tray turns to face the viewer declaiming, the lunch line moving on behind him, heavy black shadows

panels.composition: A long empty table. Wood alone at the near end with his corn. Far behind him, tiny: GULLY (backwards cap) drawing on a napkin, and CHLOE (eyeliner, Discman) reading a paperback with the cover folded back. Nobody in the room faces the same direction.

characters.pose: far back, drawing on a napkin, small
far back, reading, headphones on, small

image.prompt: wide shot of a long empty cafeteria table, a teenage boy in an overcoat alone at the near end with a plate of corn, far in the background a boy in a backwards cap drawing on a napkin and a girl with headphones reading, rain on tall windows, lots of empty table
image.notes: Silent. The margin gull first appears here.

notes: The first strip. Drawn taller than the author, per the rule. Balloons over-written on purpose.
